blurb: “Our mission is excellence,” says Lenny Cecere, proprietor of Ventosa Vineyards- and he means it. With the modus operandi of a devout perfectionist, Lenny is putting this winery on the map, one happy wine-drinker at a time. “Ventosa” translates to windy in Italian, and the name sets the stage for the winery’s Italian-inspired ambiance.
